customers.evidence: to deliver category-leading connectivity products so its customers can build and grow successful businesses today and in the future

innovation.evidence: built on 50 years of innovation, collaboration and engineering excellence

result.analyst_notes: Factual, descriptive tone centred on scale, portfolio and end markets; the company refers to itself in the third person, with no first-person voice. Customers appear only in the closing purpose clause, which frames them as beneficiaries of its products. Statements are absolute rather than hedged, with little aspirational language beyond 'today and in the future'. No employee, DEI, environmental or community commitments appear.
